paragraphs: Regardin Construction is based in Kensington, Cape Town, providing residential and commercial building, renovations and maintenance. Our services span brickwork, painting, decking, timber structures, concrete and custom designs, alongside new homes, garden hardscaping and civil projects. That range matters when the walls, surfaces and finishing work all need to come together.

Our work includes boundary walls, second-floor additions and doorway changes, as well as timber pergolas, hardwood decks, driveways, slabs and pool structures. The portfolio shows the finer details too, from painting and floor screeds to walk-in closets and concrete countertops. Whether you are changing a room or planning a larger build, start with what your property needs.

process.heading: Start with the work your property needs.
process.body: A few useful details help turn an idea into a clear project discussion. Share the space, the changes you want and any photographs or plans.

steps.title: Tell us what needs doing
steps.body: Describe the building, renovation or finishing work, and give the property location.

steps.title: Show the existing space
steps.body: Send photographs, approximate dimensions and drawings if available. Include the areas that need attention.

steps.title: Agree the work before it starts
steps.body: Discuss the scope, materials, access, timing and payment terms. Put the inclusions and exclusions in writing.
